description: AgentiSend is a transactional email API: send through verified domains with a message log, a free preflight that runs every gate a real send runs, and refusals that name the fix. Built so an agent can send on your behalf without ever exceeding a budget a person set. Unsolicited mail is refused by design; there is no tool for it.
